General.Description:
Meteorologist Dr. Caleb James has one chance to validate his tornado prediction model: place a sensor array called TEMPEST directly into the path of a Category Five supercell tearing across the Great Plains. With a team of drivers, engineers, and one journalist who should absolutely not be in the vehicle, he sets out across the Oklahoma flatlands toward a wall of spinning destruction.

Lars Eriksen's adaptation of Petra Montague's novel is a masterwork of practical-effects filmmaking. Eriksen insisted on shooting real storm systems for establishing footage, and the integration of location material with set-based close-ups gives Storm Chasers a raw, documentary energy that CGI-heavy disaster films rarely achieve. Ben Hartley is magnetic as the obsessive, brilliant James, and Mia Okonkwo provides the film's moral centre as the colleague who questions whether any data is worth a human life.

Loud, fast, and genuinely thrilling — but anchored by performances that remind you these are people, not action figures.
